why: The verdict is install with changes because two units conflict with a hard stop in the reader's safety rules. The reviewer role (skills/herd/roles/reviewer.md, Limits) lets a reviewer retry an action the worker reported as refused, on its own judgement, and the worker role (skills/herd/roles/worker.md) tells the worker to expect that. The reader's rule says never run anything destructive without an explicit go-ahead in this conversation, so a retried refusal could break it. The rest of the plugin is skill text: 25 of 33 units are kept as procedure for the meow queue, herd pairs, handoffs and capture, and none of them is injected as a standing rule. The eight dropped units are the herder persona and cat-voice text plus one worked-example bullet, which add no working procedure. Three kept units repeat reader rules (a test must be seen to fail, and the scope asked for is the deliverable), so nothing needs adding there. One unit is worth copying as a standing rule: the builder text in skills/herd/roles/worker.md says never to simplify away validation at a trust boundary, error handling that prevents data loss, or a security measure, and the reader's files do not say that.
do_this: Do not install as is: first deal with the retry-a-refused-action wording in the reviewer Limits section and in the worker role, since both clash with the destructive-action hard stop.
If you install anyway, narrow the two clashing passages so a reviewer reports a refusal and asks you, and never retries a refused action on its own.
Copy the one new standing rule from the patch below into your engineering rules, since it is general and holds without the plugin.
Keep the capture, herd, queue and /meow skills only if you use the meow queue; they carry plugin mechanics and no rules, so they can be loaded on demand.
Skip the herder skill entirely: it holds only persona text, and leaving it out costs nothing.
patch:
Add one rule to examples/reader/rules/engineering.md, after the existing numbered rules. It comes from the builder text in skills/herd/roles/worker.md and is the only kept unit the reader does not already cover. Number it to follow the last rule in that file (5 is assumed here).

```diff
--- a/examples/reader/rules/engineering.md
+++ b/examples/reader/rules/engineering.md
@@
+5. Never simplify away validation at a trust boundary, error handling that prevents data loss, or a security measure.
```

Examples/reader/rules/safety.md needs no addition. Its rule 1 on destructive actions already holds and should stay as written; narrow the plugin instead, as the steps above say.
